lignes.pinyin: zhè shì qù shàng hǎi de liè chē
lignes.en: This is the train to Shanghai.

lignes.fr: À bord, il y a de quoi manger et de quoi boire.
lignes.en: On board there's food and drink.

lignes.en: I buy a bottle of water and a bun.
